title: Settlement 4: Stakeholders (Glenfaba Rise)
subject: Geography
description: Stakeholders for and against the Glenfaba Rise housing development, and their reasons.
author: L.M.

cards.front: Name 5 stakeholders FOR the Glenfaba Rise development.
cards.back: Landowner, developer, plumber, shop owner, young resident

cards.front: Name 5 stakeholders AGAINST the Glenfaba Rise development.
cards.back: Elderly resident, local doctor, local teacher, pub owner, neighbour

cards.front: Why is the landowner FOR Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Earns money from the sale of the land

cards.front: Why is the developer FOR Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Makes money from selling the houses

cards.front: Why is the plumber FOR Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Has a secure job to earn money from

cards.front: Why is the shop owner FOR Glenfaba Rise?
Why is the young resident FOR Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Has the opportunity to buy their first house

cards.front: Why is the elderly resident AGAINST Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: It changes the feel of the town

cards.front: Why is the local doctor AGAINST Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Too busy already; it will increase wait times

cards.front: Why is the local teacher AGAINST Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: There aren't enough classrooms for more children

cards.front: Why is the pub owner AGAINST Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Not enough parking for people to leave cars

cards.front: Why is the neighbour AGAINST Glenfaba Rise?
cards.back: Visual and noise pollution during construction

questions.question: Which stakeholder is AGAINST Glenfaba Rise because there aren't enough classrooms?
questions.explanation: The local teacher worries there aren't enough classrooms for more children.

questions.question: Why is the young resident FOR the development?
options: Earns money from selling the land
questions.explanation: The young resident has the opportunity to buy their first house.

questions.question: Which stakeholder is FOR Glenfaba Rise?
questions.explanation: The plumber is for it: a secure job to earn money from. The others are against.

questions.question: Why is the local doctor AGAINST the development?
options: It changes the feel of the town
questions.explanation: The doctor's surgery is too busy already, so more people will increase wait times.

questions.question: Who earns money from the sale of the land?
questions.explanation: The landowner earns money from selling the land. The developer makes money from selling the houses.
